title: Cut the KRN-owned share of the lead startup context
body:
Outcome: the lead's first-turn context is measured by source (system prompt, global skills list, AGENTS.md, memory index, hook output, KRN skills) and the KRN-owned sources shrink by a measured amount.
Why: first-turn context median is 42k tokens (cache_creation median 13k, 12.5% of lead cache_creation) and is re-read on every turn; at 68 turns per session that prefix is ~2.9M of ~7.3M cache_read per lead session (~39%): .krn/runs/relay-no-merge/rerun.md section 3c and 3e. Each 10k tokens cut saves ~680k cache_read per session.
Proof: a before/after first-turn context number from a script under .krn/runs/; sources outside this repository (global skills, harness prompt) are reported, not edited (memory:krn-only-scope).
Scope: this repository.
